text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, Agnes Digital
was running in a mock race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The race unfolded at a slow pace.
Agnes Digital was boxed in by other Umamusume right in the middle of the pack."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The midfield remains bunched up as they head into the 4th corner!
Oh! Here comes Agnes Digital!
She bursts right through the pack!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, how was it?
My running, I mean."
choice_data_list: You broke away from the pack nicely!
You broke away from the pack nicely, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I felt like today was my day, so I just went for it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Usually, the thought of veering off
and bumping into other Umamusume
would inevitably cross my mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
My body didn't wobble at all while running today.
I felt like I could slip through even the tightest gaps!
choice_data_list: That was a nice, stable run!
That was a nice, steady run!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to building up some muscle,
I believe my running form has stabilized too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"The reason I was able to run so comfortably
is all thanks to you, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Don't hold back against the other girls,
but make sure not to cause them any trouble either!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aim for an unwavering core!!
Please keep guiding me from here on out!
